description: This file defines the AnalyticsScreen widget for a Flutter app, providing an interface to display quiz analytics, KPIs, filters, and performance breakdowns. It uses Riverpod for state management, Flutter widgets for UI, and includes various reusable components for visualizations and layout.

classes.name: AnalyticsScreen
classes.description: A Flutter widget that displays quiz analytics, KPIs, filters, and categorized performance breakdown with refresh and dynamic data updates.

classes.name: KpiCard
classes.description: A reusable widget that displays a KPI metric with title, icon, and styled layout.

classes.name: SparkBar
classes.description: A visual widget representing a compact, animated horizontal bar used for displaying proportional data.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the entire AnalyticsScreen layout, including data handling via Riverpod, and renders KPIs, filters, and quiz performance tiles.

methods.name: _filterBar
methods.description: Builds the filter controls for categories and date ranges, including preset filters and reset options.

methods.name: _isSameRange
methods.description: Checks if the current filter range matches a preset number of days.

methods.name: _isThisWeek
methods.description: Checks if the current filter corresponds to the current week.

methods.name: _isThisMonth
methods.description: Checks if the current filter corresponds to the current month.

methods.name: _isAll
methods.description: Checks if the current filter spans the last five years, representing 'All' time.

methods.name: _presetChip
methods.description: Builds a choice chip for preset day ranges.

methods.name: _weekChip
methods.description: Builds a choice chip for 'This week' selected range.

methods.name: _monthChip
methods.description: Builds a choice chip for 'This month' selected range.

methods.name: _allChip
methods.description: Builds a choice chip for 'All time' range.

methods.name: _resetChip
methods.description: Builds an ActionChip to reset filters to default.

methods.name: _rangeLabel
methods.description: Generates a string label for the selected date range.

methods.name: _quizStatTile
methods.description: Constructs a widget displaying individual quiz statistics with visual indicators.

methods.name: _pill
methods.description: Creates a small status label widget.

methods.name: _emptyStateFiltered
methods.description: Displays a message when no data matches current filters and offers a reset option.
